==Usage==
This template should be placed after an objection which is overridden following an [[Wookieepedia:EduCorps|EduCorps]] vote. EduCorps members who need to use this template simply need to put <nowiki>{{Ecstrike|~~~~~}}</nowiki> (making sure to use five ~'s) on an approved [[Wookieepedia:Comprehensive article nominations|CAN]].
